assets.purpose: Illustrative caption-style documentation; fictional host, not a product screenshot or original font preview
assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished wide 3:2 documentation illustration for Creator Flow, the podcast-to-Shorts/Reels workflow. Reference image 1 is a branding reference only: preserve the teal sliced microphone and Creator Flow name in a modest header. Ivory background, navy typography, teal/mint accents, soft studio shadows, premium editorial design, extremely readable type. Title exact "Your captions. Your style." Main composition: left a tall 9:16 video preview showing a realistic fictional adult woman podcast host speaking into a professional microphone in a warm modern studio, tasteful teal clothing. Caption on her video reads exactly "Make every word count" in white with a dark outline. Right: a spacious instructional settings card with these exact controls: "Font" value "Noto Sans"; "Size" value "64"; "Text color" with white, yellow and mint swatches; "Outline color" dark navy swatch; "Outline width" value "3". Bottom preset buttons "White", "Yellow", "Mint". Under settings, a small horizontal sequence reads "Choose style → Review → Apply to approved clips". Tiny footer exact "Illustrative preview". Show a delicate source-to-vertical-clip motif without any extra promises. Constraints: fictional person only, no real recordings, no Adobe/Meta/social platform logos, no fake separate bold/italic toggle, no autoplay or publish controls, no karaoke or moving captions. It is a documentation illustration, not a literal product screenshot. All text must be spelled accurately and readable, with generous margins.

assets.purpose: Facebook announcement artwork with fictional podcast participants

Reference image 1 is branding reference only: match its teal sliced microphone, navy wordmark and warm ivory background. Premium clean editorial technology launch design, natural photography and refined simple graphic elements, mobile-readable, strong hierarchy with generous margins. Top: the Creator Flow logo/name. Prominent Georgian headline exact "შენი ვიდეო. მეტი ფორმატი." and small Georgian badge exact "ახალი განახლება". Hero in the middle: a wide horizontal video panel with a photorealistic fictional podcast scene, two adult speakers, man and woman, speaking into microphones in a warm studio. In front/right, two elegant vertical 9:16 video cards visibly derived from the same fictional scene, featuring the woman and the man individually, with a few crisp white or yellow caption lines, exact English caption "Your story starts here". A subtle teal arrow connects the wide video to the vertical videos. Lower section has 3 large readable pill labels: "Podcasts", "Shorts", "Reels". A small elegant palette cue of white/yellow/mint swatches and a type cursor hints caption customization. Footer exact "Meta transcripts • Custom captions • Your approval". Avoid excessive UI detail, charts, clutter, robots, glowing cyberpunk, social platform logos, watermarks, fake quotations or testimonials, made-up ratings. No URL needed. Georgian headline must be accurate. Use the actual brand identity and original tasteful composition; no implication that this is a real user interface screenshot.
